measures.label: TVL
measures.what: Deposits held in the protocol’s contracts right now. Coins lent on to borrowers are not included.

measures.label: Loans outstanding
measures.what: What borrowers currently owe. This is the balance a lender earns interest on; DefiLlama leaves it out of TVL so the same coins aren’t counted twice.

feesAre.fees: Total interest and fees paid by borrowers on both fixed-term and open-term loans, including net interest, management fees, service fees, strategy fees and origination fees, plus off-chain OTC desk revenue.
feesAre.revenue: Total revenue flowing to Maple protocol and delegates, including management fees, service fees, strategy fees and origination fees from both fixed-term and open-term loans.
feesAre.holders: Share of revenue used to buy back SYRUP tokens: 20% from Jan 2025 (MIP-013/016), 25% from Jul 2025 (MIP-019), and from Jul 2026 10%, 20% or 30% of each month's revenue for months under $1.5M, $1.5M-$2M or above $2M (MIP-021).

measures.label: Tokenized assets
measures.what: The dollar value of the tokens the issuer has outstanding, added up from its listings in DefiLlama’s yields list. The assets themselves sit off-chain with a custodian, so this is the amount issued, not deposits in a contract.

measures.label: Open interest
measures.what: The dollar value of all open perpetual-futures positions. It measures trading exposure, not deposits: positions use leverage, so it can be larger than the collateral behind it.

feesAre.fees: The daily yield earned by USDY and OUSG holders, calculated as each token's price increase over the day times the amount of tokens in circulation.
feesAre.revenue: Zero. Ondo passes all of this yield to token holders and currently charges no fee (USDY has no fee, OUSG's 0.15% fee is waived until 2027).
